verdict.rationale: Gladia is a speech-to-text and audio-intelligence API, not an automation platform. It has no automation or workflow object of its own that could be versioned, reviewed, or rolled back, so the story's axis does not fit this kind of product. Any automations a user builds run on third-party hosts (Zapier, Make, n8n) or in their own scripts via the CLI. Those are host-platform and user-side capabilities and cannot be credited to Gladia.
